question: A woman travels 488 km at 61 km/hr, a second distance of 468 km at 78 km/hr and a third distance of 210 km at 35 km/hr. Find her average speed for the whole journey (in km/hr).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 488 + 468 + 210 = 1166 km

Total Time = (488/61) + (468/78) + (210/35) = 8 + 6 + 6 = 20 hours

Average Speed = 1166 ÷ 20 = 58.3 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 58.3 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/564f1111be6492839a48ffc3d2f47537898e2f05b4a1d62e3d7594b6325cb9b8.png] 

**Given:**

Distance₁ = 488 km, Speed₁ = 61 km/hr

Distance₂ = 468 km, Speed₂ = 78 km/hr

Distance₃ = 210 km, Speed₃ = 35 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time₁ = 488 ÷ 61 = 8 hours

⇒ Time₂ = 468 ÷ 78 = 6 hours

⇒ Time₃ = 210 ÷ 35 = 6 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 488 + 468 + 210 = 1166 km

⇒ Total Time = 8 + 6 + 6 = 20 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 1166 ÷ 20 = 58.3 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 58.3 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If two equal distances are covered at speeds u and v, then Average Speed = (2uv) ÷ (u + v).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is the difference of speeds (S₁ − S₂). In opposite directions, it is the sum (S₁ + S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
